description: Find IANA protocol registries and sub-registries by keyword over their titles and protocol categories, e.g. "tls cipher", "dns resource record", "protocol numbers". Returns the registry and sub-registry ids that iana_get_registry_records reads, with registration procedure and defining documents. Covers every registry linked from the IANA protocol registries index.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–50. Default 15.

offset.description: Number of matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

query.description: Words matched as whole tokens, singular or plural, against registry titles, categories, and ids, e.g. "tls cipher". An exact registry or sub-registry id ranks first, then the closest titles.

name: iana_search_registries

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `index_unreadable`: The IANA protocol index page could not be read, or it listed far fewer registries than a complete index holds, and no good copy up to 7 days old is cached. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

registries.description: Matching index entries: exact id hits first, then the closest titles.

category.description: Protocol category in the index; an entry listed under several joins them with "; ".

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

title: Search IANA registries
